checks: Service interaction requires a nearby bay, a stopped vehicle and no pursuit or search
Fuel and mechanic panels expose only their supported services
Refueling adds 5 L per second, cancellation keeps partial fuel and preserves damage/NOS
Fuel completion clamps to tank capacity and keeps the completed UI status visible
Cancelling a repair preserves the original condition and consumed resources
Completed repair restores physical parts while leaving fuel and NOS unchanged
NOS service refills the bottle independently of damage and fuel
Recovery is blocked during chase/search without moving or repairing the vehicle
Recovery moves to the nearest mechanic without repairing, refueling or refilling NOS
An empty tank recovers to the nearest fuel stop and stays empty until refueling
Arrest event pauses once; release uses the station, repairs damage, clears police and guarantees 8 L
Station release preserves fuel above the minimum and does not give a full tank
Dock recovery remains a usable fuel/repair/NOS pit when no fuel station exists
limits: Actual extracted main.js helpers, real MotorLab CarPhysics, real city service records and police reset logic.
DOM layout, animations, GPU rendering and audible playback are not verified; painting/audio devices are controlled stubs.
